entries:
Alpha 1.68.1 (reliable movement and saved-item QA)

  • Movement QA waits for the actual Idle animation before recording a no-movement baseline. A roaming enemy blocking a planned ground ray can trigger bounded target reselection before clicking, never a retry of a failed movement.
  • Frame sampling starts with the pre-input position and only after the ground-ray checks pass. All movement, camera, acknowledgement and correction thresholds remain unchanged.
  • Fresh-login loot QA waits up to ten seconds for the exact saved item or stack quantity, because private inventory delivery and world readiness are separate messages. A genuinely missing item still fails.
  • No movement-speed, combat, reward, membership, EP, payment or account-reset changes. Ilyra retains his permanent Blender-authored wizard outfit. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.68.0 (clear VIP status without replaying exchanges)

  • The EP wallet has an explicit Refresh VIP status action and a full membership expiry timestamp. Refreshing status never replays a pending Gold-to-EP exchange.
  • Membership display uses the server snapshot and elapsed time. After expiry it asks for a refresh instead of showing renewed access; the UI cannot renew membership, grant access or award EP.
  • Administrator VIP includes the existing 100 EP monthly allowance. Administrator and normal membership allowances do not stack. Membership expiry leaves existing EP and owned cosmetic looks intact.
  • No provisioning, monthly award, casino stake, combat-power, account-reset or payment changes. EP winnings remain EP; EP cannot return to Gold or buy player power. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.67.0 (preview your look and keep your earned gear)

  • The cosmetic vendor previews fitted looks and their EP prices before you confirm. A changed or retired offer cannot reuse an old purchase button; loading catalogs are not purchasable.
  • Wardrobe actions wait for valid replies belonging to your character. Closing a panel or switching character retires old controls; refreshing the same collection preserves it. Original gear restores your earned item's appearance.
  • Cosmetic looks use the delivered fitted class equipment and independent preview materials. Your underlying item, class eligibility, combat stats and earned gear remain unchanged; cosmetic ownership does not travel with traded gear.
  • Private vendor, wardrobe, wallet and VIP replies are checked before updating your character. No new prices, player power, Gold conversion, account reset or purchase method. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.66.0 (safer EP wallet and exchange receipts)

  • Gold converts to EP only at the fixed rate of 1,000,000 Gold for 1 EP. EP can fund EP casino games and cosmetic unlocks, never Gold or player power. Existing balances and monthly allowances are unchanged.
  • Wallet and VIP replies identify their character before updating the menu or character badge. Retired menus and replies for another character cannot overwrite balances or finish your exchange.
  • Exchange confirmations must match your saved request and contain valid final balances and the fixed rate. Pending receipts remain pending instead of inventing a successful exchange.
  • Nearby players no longer receive your Gold, XP progress or private skill/talent allocations through world updates. Your own character UI, visible equipment and combat effects are unchanged.
  • Cosmetic ownership stays with its owner when normal gear is sold, auction-listed, traded or banked. No reverse conversion, new awards, account reset or purchase method. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.65.0 (keep your slot queue through the bonus)

  • Slot reels animate before the saved result appears. A queued run pauses for bonus choices and saved bonus reveals, then resumes its remaining spins. Bonus choices do not consume queued spins.
  • Win celebrations finish before the next automatic spin. Stop remains available during bonuses; exiting, disconnecting, changing character or losing synchronization cancels unstarted queued spins. Reconnecting never silently restores an old queue.
  • Retired bonus buttons cannot act on later results. Fresh saved revisions drive reveals; unchanged updates do not replay outcomes or repeatedly scroll the panel.
  • Themed machines retain their published mechanics and rules. No random-dealing, paytable, reward, wallet, account-reset or payment changes. Limits remain 100,000 Gold or 100 EP; EP cannot return to Gold or buy player power. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.64.1 (safe house-table wager details)

  • Roulette and baccarat keep seats and controls visible when wager details are unavailable, instead of crashing the table. Missing details do not become a zero stake, a confirmed wager or a win.
  • The panel asks you to refresh and blocks another wager for that participant until the next authoritative round. Server-owned stakes, payouts, timers and currencies are unchanged.
  • The full-casino lifecycle browser fixture now supplies the server's house-table wager format. The failed 1.64.0 candidate was not accepted live; Ilyra's permanent archmage outfit remains intact.
  • Full prior patch history remains below. No new rewards, payment methods or closed-beta access changes.

Alpha 1.64.0 (clearer roulette and baccarat betting)

  • Roulette and baccarat retain shared rounds and server-owned countdowns. Confirmed spots and slip totals are clearer; refreshing betting options does not restart the clock.
  • A changed betting catalog clears only stale unconfirmed drafts, with an explanation. Detached boards and closed panels cannot submit old wagers.
  • Processing messages distinguish saving a wager from saving its return. Displayed results do not grant money; the server owns accepted stakes and payouts.
  • No rules, odds, wallets, account resets or payment changes. Limits remain 100,000 Gold or 100 EP; EP cannot return to Gold or buy player power. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.63.0 (clearer shared Hold’em hands and saved cash-outs)

  • Hold’em remains real-player-only, with shared rounds, private hole cards and your current best hand. Earlier hands identify their original owners when chairs change; hidden opponent cards stay private.
  • A 30-second decision timeout checks when free or folds to a bet. The server releases only the current funded chair, only after saving the decision, and cannot evict a later patron. A departing stack follows normal withdrawal; committed pots and all-in eligibility are preserved.
  • Saved timeout releases can retry safely after a restart. Cash-outs show a pending return until settlement is saved; a win celebration waits for confirmed completion.
  • Limits remain 100,000 Gold or 100 EP. EP winnings stay EP and cannot return to Gold or buy player power. No dealing, pot, payout, account-reset or payment changes. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.62.1 (more resilient character downloads)

Browser asset caching should help your character load, not stop an available model from reaching you.

  • Keep available models loading: unavailable browser cache reads fall back to the normal download. Cache quota or write failures no longer produce unhandled errors after a successful asset download.
  • Recover brief network interruptions: a rejected asset GET receives one bounded retry inside the worker before failing. Persistent network failures and HTTP errors remain visible; cancelled requests and non-GET actions are never replayed.
  • Keep your character: authored bodies, fitted gear, Ilyra's permanent wizard outfit and all gameplay rules are unchanged. No account reset, wager or currency changes. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.62.0 (clearer blackjack hands and next wagers)

Prepare your next stake while watching a shared hand, with clear saved payouts and reliable chair turnover.

  • Prepare the next wager: wager controls remain visible while the hand plays. Changing Next wager never changes your confirmed stake or automatically places another bet; the next betting window still requires your click. Hit, Stand, Split and Double stay ahead of those controls on phones.
  • Reliable timeout seating: a 30-second decision timeout stands the current hand and releases its current funded chair only after saving the transition. Reconnected players in that chair remain its owners; a different seat or later patron cannot be ejected by an old timeout. Saved release retries preserve accepted wagers and ordinary settlement.
  • Know your result: natural blackjack remains 3:2 profit, an ordinary win 1:1, and a push returns the stake. Results show pending return until payout is saved. A departed participant's earlier hand is labeled separately from a new chair occupant; the dealer's hidden card stays private.
  • Keep your currency: public tables wager and return Gold; VIP tables wager and return only EP. Limits remain 100,000 Gold or 100 EP. No odds, payout amounts, account reset, automatic wagers or Gold/EP conversion changes. Full prior patch history remains below.
